message: The other day, I realized our smoke alarms hadn't been checked in a while. So, I turned it into a little family event—everyone got to push the test button and hear that reassuring beep! 🔔 It was a fun reminder to talk about our escape plan and kitchen safety while enjoying some homemade cookies. Who knew checking smoke alarms could lead to such a cozy evening? How do you turn safety tasks into family time?
